&&t=1,\ldots,144,
\\
&
E_0=6000,
\\
&
E_{144}=6000,
\\
&
0\le C_t\le Q_{\max}u_t,
&&t=1,\ldots,144,
\\
&
0\le D_t\le Q_{\max}(1-u_t),
&&t=1,\ldots,144,
\\
&
0\le W_t\le S_t,
&&t=1,\ldots,144,
\\
&
G_t\ge0,
&&t=1,\ldots,144,
\\
&
u_t\in\{0,1\},
&&t=1,\ldots,144.
\end{aligned}
}
